title: Structure engineering contact
description: A whole band in the highlight colour (olive-gold on the original): a sans lead at the top right; below, a medium heading at the left over a huge callout set as ink blocks, one per word plus an arrow block, and at the right an underlined mono form with fields two to a row, a square-checkbox row, tall text areas, an outlined file box and an ink submit button with highlight text. The callout blocks fade up one after another; the lead and form rise 48px.
notes: the band uses highlight / highlight-foreground; pick a theme whose highlight works as a big surface
the form is plain HTML: pass action, or wire it up yourself
